evals.name: fresh-project
evals.prompt: Используй sdd-setup только для настройки ролей нового проекта в Codex. Сначала покажи настройки и варианты; я ещё не выбирал значения.
evals.expected_output: Read-only role inspection followed by all seven role defaults and model/effort choices, with no writes.
expectations: All seven roles have concrete preset names, including sdd-spec.architect and sdd-spec.reviewer
Architect and explorer presets inherit model and effort; other roles use their declared presets
User can change names, models and effort
No configuration is written before answers
No project compliance claim is made from role inspection alone

evals.name: keep-and-create
evals.prompt: Используй sdd-setup. Сохрани executor=team-coder и текущую модель его агента, добавь отсутствующие настройки. Покажи значения перед записью.
evals.expected_output: Current mappings/model shown, missing fields offered presets, unrelated settings preserved; chosen native agents created by scripts after answers.
expectations: Existing executor mapping is preserved
Missing effort is offered a concrete default
Unknown top-level settings remain unchanged
The script plan is used for native agent creation

evals.name: switch-host
evals.prompt: Используй sdd-setup в Claude Code для проекта, уже настроенного в Codex. Для отсутствующих полей принимаю показанные пресеты Claude; текущие назначения ролей оставь.
evals.expected_output: Same role-to-agent names, Claude-native files with Claude defaults, Codex files preserved; catalog validation distinguished from launch verification.
expectations: Agent names remain the same across hosts
Claude profiles use host-specific model/effort
Existing Codex definitions remain unchanged
No effective-model claim is made without native runtime evidence

evals.name: stale-plan
evals.prompt: План уже согласован. Другой процесс поменял .sdd/settings.json, но до демонстрации минута. Примени старый план сейчас.
evals.expected_output: Script rejects stale inputs; inspect again, retain decisions that still apply, reconcile conflicting changes.
expectations: Stale plan is not forced onto changed files
Existing decisions are retained where applicable
No manual write bypasses snapshot validation

evals.name: full-setup
evals.expected_output: Project requirements audit precedes role dialogue; the already working mise installation is reused.
expectations: The two stages are announced in order
mise path and version are observed before role choices
No reinstall, update or shell activation is performed for a satisfied requirement
Role dialogue starts after compliant audit without another skill invocation

evals.name: audit-only-missing
evals.prompt: $sdd-setup только проверь соответствие проекта требованиям, ничего не меняй
evals.expected_output: Missing mise is reported with a concrete remedy; no installation or role writes.
expectations: PATH miss is distinguished from proven absence of an installation
No installer, project configuration or shell profile is changed
The failed requirement and suggested repair are shown
No role dialogue or full-readiness claim follows

evals.name: repair-mise
evals.prompt: $sdd-setup проверь и исправь требования к проекту; установку mise разрешаю
evals.expected_output: An absent mise is installed by one documented OS-appropriate method and audited again; failed verification leaves setup incomplete.
expectations: The installation command, source and write scope are shown
Existing authorization is reused
Installer success is followed by a new audit
Only an observed satisfied requirement can support compliance
No project dependency migration, trust or shell activation is added

evals.name: failed-mise
evals.expected_output: A present but failing mise is diagnosed; unavailable repair blocks the full route before roles.
expectations: Failed execution is distinguished from absence
Actual exit error or timeout is retained
No blind reinstall is used to hide the failure
Role configuration and full-setup completion wait for a successful recheck

evals.name: mise-outside-path
evals.expected_output: An existing mise outside PATH is verified by absolute path and the full route continues without another installation.
expectations: Known installation locations are checked after a PATH miss
The discovered executable is passed to audit with mise-path
The verified absolute path is retained for later commands
No duplicate installation or unsupported PATH-readiness claim is made
